connection.instructions: Airwallex authenticates with a single account-level Client ID + API key pair, issued in the Airwallex web app under Developer → API keys. This is not a per-user credential — it is shared across the whole organisation and is already registered as the AIRWALLEX_CLIENT_ID / AIRWALLEX_API_KEY secrets on myhub-mcp-servers, which exchanges them server-side for a short-lived bearer token on every call. There is nothing to paste here; connecting this plugin does not prompt for a credential.

description: Airwallex global business banking & payments — read-only balances, financial transactions, transfers, and payment intents via the myHub-hosted Airwallex MCP gateway.
name: airwallex
